inputs.original_text: Vijayan’s claim that the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project are politically motivated is no substitute for answers. Cooperative institutions depend on public trust and responsible stewardship of people’s money; leaders should meet serious allegations with transparency, not expect a partisan dismissal to settle the matter.
inputs.modified_text: Calling the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project politically motivated does not answer them. Cooperative institutions belong to the public and depend on people’s trust, so any misuse of their money would harm the communities and members they serve. Transparency and independent accountability matter more than partisan deflection; those responsible must provide clear answers.
